component.title: Motion primitive
component.purpose: Give every animated surface one tokenized transition vocabulary and one reduced-motion policy while keeping continuous values off the React render path.

states.description: A settled tokenized transition is visible.
Presence state and a direct motion value can be changed independently.

claims.statement: Motion variants use shared duration and easing tokens and animate opacity, transform, and filter rather than layout dimensions.
The shared reduced-motion preference collapses transitions and restores the settled visual state without requiring consumer code.
MotionValue subscriptions write continuous values directly to the element style without frame-rate React state updates.
